case.summary: Case CASE-014 (Card C13487-K1): Transaction 3478561 on card C13487‑K1 was an online purchase of $74.96 (product C) made from a new Android mobile device (SM‑G935F Build/NRD90M) using an anonymous proxy (evidence [HIGH] Device marked ‘New’ for this account; evidence [MEDIUM] Proxy or anonymous connection used). The same device profile is linked to 19 other cards (evidence [HIGH] Device profile shared across 19 other card(s)) and the activity matches an undocumented coordinated pattern with a fraud probability of 0.53 and medium risk, similar to prior confirmed cases (CC‑4086, CC‑4124, CC‑3907, CC‑3748, CC‑3841). Because no customer response was received within 24 hours, the deterministic final policy actions were applied: MONITOR_CARD (auto) per R4 and DECLINE_TRANSACTION (L1) per R4 (added: DECLINE_TRANSACTION, MONITOR_CARD; removed: ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST, FILE_REPORT, CREATE_CASE).
